Class FramePort

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.FramePort
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class FramePort extends Object implements Serializable
A small connection point on a Petri-object frame's border, standing in for one of the object's own places or transitions.

Once an element belongs to a frame it is locked on the shared canvas — it can only be moved or rewired inside that object's own editor. A port is how the object still takes part in the composition from the outside: it is what a cross-object link is drawn to and from, labelled with the element's name so the connection is legible without opening the object.
